# qdrant-cloud_serverless_space_api_keys (Data Source)

Serverless Space API Keys Data Source

## Example Usage

```terraform
// Setup Terraform, including the qdrant-cloud providers
terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.7.0"
  required_providers {
    qdrant-cloud = {
      source  = "qdrant/qdrant-cloud"
      version = ">=1.30.0"
    }
  }
}

// Add the provider to specify some provider wide settings
provider "qdrant-cloud" {
  api_key    = "" // API Key generated in Qdrant Cloud (required)
  account_id = "" // The default account ID you want to use in Qdrant Cloud (can be overriden on resource level)
}

data "qdrant-cloud_serverless_space_api_keys" "all" {
  space_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000" // Update with the space ID
}

output "keys" {
  value = data.qdrant-cloud_serverless_space_api_keys.all.keys
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `space_id` (String) Serverless Space API Key Schema ID of the serverless space to list the API keys for field

### Optional

- `account_id` (String) Serverless Space API Key Schema Account ID (defaults to the provider account ID) field

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `keys` (List of Object) List of API keys of the serverless space (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--keys))
